task_instance: Audit the file/module organization of a small sample Python package (sample_project/backend/, 11 flat source files deliberately seeded with layout smells) and produce the structured layout-smell findings report that is the skill's core deliverable.
evidence: Skill is a methodology (no bundled script to run); both SKILL.md and references/smell-catalog.md were present. Built a realistic sample package under the work dir with planted smells, then executed the workflow. Step 1: `find -maxdepth 1 -name '*.py'` + wc -l mapped 11 files with line counts. Step 4: wrote analyze.py using ast.parse to extract ImportFrom nodes, built the sibling import adjacency list and in/out-degree, counted re-exports vs local defs, and scanned filenames for prefix clusters, junk-drawer and shadow-name patterns; a shell loop counted source files per subdirectory for premature packages. Detection correctly fired on every seeded smell: prefix cluster 'agent' (5 files, HIGH) and 'corpus' (3 files, MEDIUM); shim facade corpus.py (2 re-exports, 0 local defs, noqa F401); shadow name agent_helpers.py; junk drawer utils.py (4 unrelated defs); orphan module legacy_exporter.py (0 importers); premature package middleware/ (1 source file). Step 5 deliverable written to layout-smells-report.md (58 lines, 7 findings grouped by smell with severity, files+line counts, evidence, remediation, and a summary count table). Verified the report content against the analyzer output and the known planted smells; all matched. Files: work dir .../real2_work/r020 contains analyze.py, layout-smells-report.md, smell-catalog.md (copied), and sample_project/backend/.
